purpose: PREREGISTRATION.md §15.2: the frozen OSV snapshot the RD candidate pool is built from

durable_copies.medium: the user's NAS (a Windows drive mapped as Z:)
durable_copies.verification: byte sizes and SHA-256 (Windows Get-FileHash) equal the manifest for both zips; the bytes are identical to the local copy, which passed osv_verify.py (size, SHA-256, zip integrity)

restore: copy the two zips from a durable copy into local_dir (or any directory) and run `uv run python experiments/rd/osv_verify.py <dir>`; build the candidate pool only from a copy that passes

restore_drills.result: OK: osv_verify.py passed (byte sizes, SHA-256, zip integrity) on the restored copy
